title: Sprint-slice orchestration: stabilize weekly RCs and automated changelog pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a predictable weekly cut process that produces stable release candidates (RCs) sliced per sprint and an automated changelog pipeline that reduces manual work for release owners. This ticket drives a coordinated set of automation and gating rules: (1) slice-based RC creation tied to sprint boundaries, (2) deterministic RC tagging and promotion rules across LTS/minor channels, (3) automated health and regression gates (latency/cost/functional tests), and (4) a changelog generation bot that aggregates PR metadata and AI-assisted summaries for reviewer edits.
acceptance_criteria: Weekly build produces a tagged RC artifact automatically on schedule (every Wednesday 04:00 UTC)
RC promotion pipeline enforces automated gates: e2e pass, P95 latency delta < 5% vs baseline, error-rate delta < 0.5%, test flakiness < 1% over 3 runs
Canary rollout phases are automated (1%, 10%, 100%) with rollback on gate failures
Changelog-bot creates draft release notes grouped by type (feat/fix/perf/docs) with PR links and AI summary suggestion, and stores them in the release draft for human approval
Promotion to LTS channel requires manual signoff by release lead but is pre-populated with metrics and checklist in the release draft
All steps are wired into the CI/CD release pipeline and documented in the release runbook
steps: Design: finalize gating thresholds and metric sources (observability dashboards, test harness)
Implement: automation job that slices commits between sprint tags and creates an RC branch and semver tag
Integrate: wire RC artifact creation to CI and snapshot baseline performance metrics
Gate: add automated verification jobs (e2e/regressions/perf smoke) that report to the release job
Changelog: deploy changelog-bot GitHub app that aggregates merged PRs, parses labels and bodies, and runs an AI summarizer to propose bullet points
Rollout: implement progressive canary orchestration with guard rails and automatic abort on gating failure
Docs: update release runbook and console notes generator to reference the new changelog draft location
notes: We intentionally use sprint-slice boundaries rather than heuristics from commit volume to keep release artifacts traceable to PM scope.
Changelog-bot will respect PR-level labels (type:feat/type:fix/perf/docs) and fail open if no labels are present; maintainers should add labels to PR templates.
AI summaries are suggestions only and must be editable from the release draft before publish due to potential hallucinations.
LTS promotion remains gated on a manual approval step until the first 3 LTS candidates pass without rollback in prod for 4 weeks.
We will sample performance baselines from the last stable release and require full Canary runs for any release that touches serving runtime or kernel selection code paths.
